targets.dataFlow: Update Reject Management With Fund Enrolment
targets.writeCondition: Data flow runs after the (disabled) Create FundEnrolment For Transfer Request (Success constraint DTSX 15645; disabled predecessor does not block). Rows (UNION SQL DTSX 14666): active (statecode = 0) gen_rejectmanagement with gen_fundenrolmentid NULL whose automated joining / pension joining / transfer request has a gen_fundenrolment and gen_isoldrejectmethod != 1 or NULL. Script updates only when both ids not NULL; exceptions → Failure → Derived Column (dead end). Multiple rows per reject-management record are possible only (a) in the automated-joining branch, which joins on fe.Gen_automatedjoining = aj.gen_automatedjoiningId (not unique: one automated joining can have several gen_fundenrolment records), or (b) when one gen_rejectmanagement is linked to several sources (automated joining / pension joining / transfer request) whose fund enrolments differ. The pension and transfer-request branches join on the fund enrolment id held by the joining/request (pj.gen_fundenrolmentid / tr.gen_fundenrolmentid = fe.Gen_fundenrolmentId, query lines 10 and 17) and match at most one. In cases (a)/(b) the record is updated once per row — last processed row wins, order undefined (UNION, no ORDER BY, SQL DTSX 14666).

unresolved.reason: Bridge via staging table TblFundEnrolments ("select *") is not deterministically resolved by the lineage tool; the analyst bridge (writers: Insert To TemporaryTable in Create Fundenrolment and in Create FundEnrolment For Pension) is documented in recordKey. Only matters for which records get gen_ismailsend = 0, not for any value.

notes.note: Disabled data flow (excluded from active writes): "Package\Create FundEnrolment For Transfer Request" (DTS:Disabled="True", DTSX 8160). It would have created gen_fundenrolment via SDK (Create Fund Enrolment, ~37 attributes incl. gen_transferrequestid, gen_handlingentity, gen_referentname, gen_rejection_description_for_contact), updated Gen_fundenrolmentBase OwnerId = reject team / OwnerIdType = 9 (SQL, DTSX 11069) and gen_transferrequestBase.gen_fundenrolmentid (SQL, DTSX 11114), and inserted into the GLOBAL TEMP table ##TblFundEnrolments on [CRM] (Insert To TemporaryTable, DTSX 10191 — not the staging TblFundEnrolments on GENERIX_STAGING used by the active flows). None of these execute.

Owner assignment by direct SQL on Gen_fundenrolmentBase (Update Owner, Update Fund Enrolment Owner) and link by direct SQL on gen_pensionjoiningBase (Upate Pension Joining) are UNSUPPORTED writes on the CRM database [CRM] = psql/altshuler_mscrm (DTSX 4); they bypass CRM plugins, auditing and sharing/POA (PrincipalObjectAccess) handling for the ownership change.

Create gen_fundEnrolment: the package never updates gen_automatedjoining.gen_lastsyncdate; repeat creation is prevented only by the full-cache Lookup on existing gen_fundenrolment. A joining with N transfer requests (LEFT JOIN gen_transferrequest) produces N rows in the same run; the lookup cache was loaded before the run, so N gen_fundenrolment records can be created for one automated joining.

Create gen_fundEnrolment: gen_enrolmentstatus = 1 is set only when gen_closedate is not NULL; otherwise the CRM default applies. Conditional Split "No CreateRow" is dead (requires JoiningStatus != 2 while the source selects only status 2).

Create gen_fundEnrolment: gen_closedate / gen_application_receipt_date are built in SQL as DATEADD(hh,3,…) then CONVERT(…,103) (dd/mm/yyyy) and re-parsed with ParseExact "dd/MM/yyyy" — the time part is lost and the +3h shift is a fixed offset (no DST handling). The pension flow copies gen_datestampreceived as DateTime without shift.
Create Fund Enrolment (pension): gen_contactname/gen_enrolmentid get a LEADING SPACE (" first last") because the code starts with "" + " " + first name (main.cs:202-203); no Trim.

Create Fund Enrolment (pension): gen_ispension = true is guarded by gen_newsletterapproval not NULL (main.cs:284-285) — probably a copy/paste guard; pension enrolments with NULL newsletter approval are not flagged gen_ispension.

Create Fund Enrolment (pension): gen_brokernumber is assigned twice with the same value (main.cs:163-164 and 178-179). Inputs not used by the code: gen_fundenrolmentid (always NULL by the source filter), gen_isoldrejectmethod; gen_rejectreasonsnotes is used only through gen_note.

Create Fund Enrolment (pension): when gen_passedandreject == true the owner becomes gen_updatedbyreferent (OwnerIdType 8). If gen_updatedbyreferent is NULL, reading Row.genupdatedbyreferent in SSIS throws (column is null) inside the try → the row goes to the unconnected CustingError output and no fund enrolment is created (behaviour of the SSIS buffer accessor; not tested).

Script string outputs gen_notes (wstr 4000) and gen_note (wstr 1000) can receive longer concatenations than their declared width (see scriptOutputs) — an over-long value raises an exception in a script without try/catch and would fail the data flow (risk, not observed).
Create gen_fundEnrolment / Create Fund Enrolment errors are routed to CastingError / CustingError outputs that are not connected — failed creations are silently dropped (no log).

Update Reject Management With Fund Enrolment: column Gen_fundenrolmentId is declared ReadWrite but the script does not modify it; no readWriteModifications apply. Rows with a NULL id are not directed to any output (dropped).
Insert To TemporaryTable (both flows) and Truncate Table TblFundEnrolments write only to staging (GENERIX_STAGING) — a hop toward Update FundEnrolment (gen_ismailsend = 0), not a CRM write.
